name: playwright-ai-summary-release-gate
description: Server-validated, deterministic Playwright release gate for an AI-assisted ticket summary feature

scripts.test:regression: INTENTIONAL_CITATION_REGRESSION=1 playwright test tests/summary.spec.ts --grep "invalid cross-ticket citations"
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run test:contracts && npm run test:evaluation && npm run test:api && npm test
